cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've rolled up my sleeves like you. Big concert tonight; admit you need an extra stagehand.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm rolling them up to wash my hands. I'm the pianist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Preparing the hands. Mine are ready too, whenever you need them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You could hold my coat while I play.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, the coat. Give it here—and tell the organizer you needed me for your performance.
